name: Prince Snow
source:
(Based on Snow Queen from "The Snow Queen")

Once the crown prince of Snow Kingdom, Snow has had quite the fall from grace. As punishment for the scandals that arose from his skirt-chasing habits and his lack of concern for his royal duties, his father and stepmother threw him out onto the streets to fend for himself, ordering him to return only after he had settled down with a worthy maiden.
Flirtatious and charming, Snow knows exactly what a woman wants to hear - and isn't afraid to say it. He has had his fair share of lovers and openly claims he isn't looking for love, yet there is a strange haunting sadness in his eyes as he does so. Despite his many flaws and secrets, Snow is a resourceful and kind man who just might prove to be a good king if given the chance.
